t: In front of you is the Battle of Britain Monument, a sculpture on the Victoria Embankment overlooking the River Thames. It commemorates the individuals who took part in the Battle of Britain during the Second World War. It was made by Paul Day, a British sculptor whose high-relief work in terracotta, resin and bronze has been exhibited widely in Europe. He is known for an unusual approach to perspective, which is worth looking for as you take in the carved scenes.
